profile.headline: 🎖 Senior Software Engineer ★ Systems Architect ► Elevating User Experiences and Operational Efficiency | Accelerating Enterprise Software Solutions and Innovation
profile.summary:
My journey in software engineering extends over a decade, infused with a commitment to software development, capturing everything from user-centric designs to enterprise-grade deployment. Specializing in full software development lifecycle, I have honed a skillset that covers diverse technologies and methodologies to refine operational effectiveness and amplify user satisfaction.

Starting with the fundamentals of backend and frontend development, my expertise stretches across Agile methodologies, cloud computing, microservices architecture, and maintaining security standards. Each project offers a new set of challenges and learning opportunities, but my core focus remains on delivering software solutions that drive business success and adapt to market needs.

Highlights of my professional journey:

🌟 Developed a proprietary .NET tool, which cut test cycle times by 40%, allowing for rapid iteration and improved market responsiveness.

🌟 By implementing scalable caching strategies using .NET 5, Redis, and Angular, I increased server throughput by 80%, boosting the authorization process and system stability during peak loads.

🌟 My introduction of feature-flagging for API services raised deployment frequency by 30% and reduced upgrade-related issues by 40%, facilitating easier future upgrades and ongoing maintenance.

My role at SkyKick involved agile process adaptations, which halved our project delivery timelines. I led the development of a Docker-based subscription management system, reducing billing errors and achieving cost savings for the company. Additionally, my efforts in optimizing software deployment processes via Azure DevOps shortened release cycles, enhancing our team's agility.

At Nice InContact, I influenced the redesign and migration of legacy software to modern frameworks, improving performance metrics and user experience. My initiatives elevated the technical prowess of our solutions and reinforced compliance and operational integrity through advanced security implementations.

My commitment goes beyond just code; I am involved in mentoring new engineers, believing that knowledge sharing strengthens the entire team. As technology evolves, so does my approach to software development, always looking for better ways to solve complex problems and deliver value to users and stakeholders alike.

This blend of technical acumen, strategic thinking, and leadership drives my quest for excellence in the software engineering field, ensuring that with each line of code, I'm not just solving problems—I'm setting new benchmarks.

Let’s connect!

★ Implemented a CI/CD pipeline in Azure DevOps, reducing software release cycles by 30%, bolstering the team's ability to adapt quickly to market changes.

★ Designed and implemented a .NET tool for managing test data, reducing test cycle times by 40%; boosted productivity and accelerated the software development lifecycle.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
★ Led the complete redesign and migration of legacy software to .NET Core REST APIs and Angular frameworks, increasing system response times and halving memory usage.

★ Integrated role-based access control with JWT in .NET Core 3.1, strengthening system security and reducing unauthorized access by 40%.

★ Optimized AWS Lambda functions using Node.js, improving cross-platform synchronization and reducing failure rates from 20% to less than 1%.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
★ Increased code coverage by 30% by integrating automated testing frameworks such as NUnit, Protractor, and Jasmine, elevating software reliability and performance. 

★ Developed a seamless integration for a third-party API using .NET Core 2 and Angular, boosting sales leads by 20% through improved data exchange and lead generation processes. 

★ Enhanced team collaboration and reduced deployment issues by 25% as a team deployment lead, focusing on effective documentation practices alongside DevOps teams.

positions.title: Staff Software Integration Engineer
positions.description:
★ Directed the development of a testing strategy that mitigated over 90% of critical bugs, stabilizing software solutions post-deployment.

★ Designed and developed over 100 scalable applications integrated with customer platforms, improving data synchronization and user engagement across diverse systems.

★ Created a reusable payment system utilizing Stripe, widely adopted by hundreds of business clients, streamlining operations and ensuring transaction accuracy.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Technician
positions.description:
★ Test California’s largest real estate multiple listing service, along with other vendor applications for critical bugs and business rules using Firebug.

★ Code scripts using JavaScript to assist the compliance department process data integrity violations by automating common tasks.
